text: Date Update Content 2026/10/7 [New Models]-Vidu Q4 preview：More Authentic Performances: Supports reference voices for greater vocal consistency, more natural emotion, and characters that truly know how to perform.Smoother Motion: Handles high-dynamic scenes with fluidity—from martial arts and running to intense confrontations, complex actions flow seamlessly from start to finish.More Spectacular Effects: Explosions, fireworks, particles, and energy effects are rendered naturally, with finer detail and greater visual impact—even in complex VFX scenes.Stronger Cinematic Quality: Upgraded image quality, lighting, aesthetics, and cinematic camera language, with support for 2K and 4K output.More References: Supports up to 15 reference images, making it easier to combine multiple creative elements into complex concepts.More Efficient Creation: Better results, faster generation, and lower production costs. 2026/9/15 [New Models]- Vidu S2-Avatar: Real-Time Interactive Model Supports real-time voice interaction and complex motion control. Important update! Starting November 3, 2025, all credits on the Vidu open platform will be inflated by 10x Your credit balance and the number of credits consumed when calling each API will be multiplied by 10 This credit inflation only adjusts the credit quantity; the actual value of credits remains unchanged See the Credit Inflation Explanation for details [New Video Replacement API] You can use this
